find_hint: Find the entities and relations named in the files on this device
clear_confirm: Remove the entities and relations found in your files? Your files and the entries added by hand stay.
origin_both: Added by hand and found in your files
confirm_model: Look for entities and relations in {n} {n:file|files} with your AI model? Passages of these files are sent to the model you set up. Every relation it names is checked against the passage it cites.
status_idle: Find the people, organizations and things your files name, and how they relate. Every relation is checked against the passage it comes from; without an AI model, names that appear together are linked.
status_no_files: There are no files on this device yet. Add some under Add knowledge first.
status_mode_model: Found by an AI model and checked against each cited passage.
status_mode_cooccurrence: Names that appear in the same sentence; no AI model was used.
status_mode_mixed: Partly found by an AI model, partly names that appear in the same sentence.
status_dropped: {n} unsupported {n:relation was|relations were} left out because the cited passage does not name both ends.
status_limited: The graph shows the best connected entities found; {n} more {n:is|are} left out.
status_up_to_date: Your files were already read; there is nothing new to find.
status_cancelled: Stopped. The files read completely are kept.
status_deferred: {n} more {n:file is|files are} left; find again to continue.
status_failed: Your files could not be read. Try again.
status_shared_missing: The shared knowledge base is not available; the graph shows what was found in your files.
